title: Chopper scene library
description: Where Chopper may appear (zones, owned by layouts), how often (rules), how every image is drawn (drawing), the props and supporting cast, every scene and its renders, the set pieces made of several images, and the story threads that order them. The site's cameo picker reads only this file. See docs/design/chopper.md.

maxPerPage.description: Most moments on one page. A moment is one scene or one set piece

maxInViewport.description: Most moments visible at once. A set piece's parts count as one moment

minGapViewports.description: Least distance between two moments on one page, in viewport heights

historySize.description: Recent moments not repeated within a browsing session

statusesShown.description: Render statuses the live site may show

maxImagesPerPage.description: Most cameo images on one page, counting every part of a set piece

maxPartsPerSetPiece.description: Most images in one set piece

maxPropsPerImage.description: Most props drawn in one image

minCandidatesPerZone.description: A zone shows Chopper only once it has at least this many approved moments at its size, so a reload brings something new

preferDaypart.description: Favour threads whose daypart matches the visitor's local time, read in the browser and never stored or sent

drawing.description: The drawing standard: every image is drawn for the size it is shown at, with one line width and one scale per size class.

masterFactor.description: k: a master is drawn at k times its shipped 2x size, and every image is reduced by exactly 1/k. One value for every image; changing it means redrawing all of them

lineCssPx.description: The ink line's width as shown, in CSS px, the same in every image and size

lineTolerance.description: Allowed deviation of the measured line width, as a fraction

scaleTolerance.description: Allowed deviation of his head height from the size class, as a fraction

canvases.description: Generation canvases, each at or near the model's smallest supported area

frameToken.description: The token for the zone's reserved height

headCssPx.description: His head height as shown (top of fringe to chin): the class's scale, whatever the pose

zones.description: Named cameo zones. Layouts declare which zones they have; views never place Chopper.

minBreakpoint.description: Smallest breakpoint token at which the zone exists

align.description: Which side of the zone a single scene sits on. Set pieces need either

props.description: Every object that may be drawn with him, described once so it looks the same in every scene. Drawn at true scale to him, in his style

kind.description: toy: his toys; household: things around the home, cut off cleanly where they leave the frame; nature: outdoor things and small creatures drawn as in a cast sheet; effect: droplets, bubbles, earth, a sun patch

cast.description: Supporting characters. Each has its own sheet in his style, approved before any scene uses it, and appears only in set pieces with him

render.description: One image of a scene, drawn for one size class. A scene shown at two sizes is drawn twice, never resized

canvas.description: The canvas name from drawing.canvases it was generated on

lineCssPx.description: Measured median ink line width as shown

canon.description: Good enough to pass as a reference for new renders

id.description: Permanent ID; also the file name stem

subject.description: chopper, or a cast ID for a supporting character's image

standalone.description: false: shown only as part of a set piece. Always false for a cast subject

action.description: What the subject is doing, in plain words; goes into the prompt

mood.description: One of the character sheet's expressions

facing.description: Generated as drawn; never mirrored, because the black patch is asymmetric

props.description: IDs from props, at most rules.maxPropsPerImage

renders.description: One render for each size class among its zones

motion.description: settle: fade in with a small rise; none when reduced motion is on

setPiece.description: Several separate images placed together as one moment, such as a squirrel at one side and Chopper sniffing toward it from the other

zones.description: Zones it can play in. All parts go in the same zone, on their sides, inside one screenful

minBreakpoint.description: Narrower than this, the parts would crowd; the zone's own minimum also applies

side.description: Physical side; a part faces toward the other part

thread.description: A short story told across moments: beats in order, shown top to bottom on a page and continued across page views

title.description: For the scene gallery only; never shown on the site

daypart.description: When in his day the story happens. With rules.preferDaypart, the picker favours threads that match the visitor's local time
